flows.title: Filter and view transactions
steps: Open the Transactions page to see the Cashflow and Top Money Movements graphs, which adjust automatically to match any filters you apply.
Use Quick Filters to narrow transactions by Date, Amount, or Keyword, or click the Filters menu for more specific filters like Category, Merchant Type, Team Member, Method, or GL Code.
Use the Customize menu to sort transactions by Date, Amount, or Account, or group them by Merchant Type, Card, or Category.

flows.title: Export transaction data
steps: Click Export all, or apply filters and click Export filtered.
Choose the format, .csv or .xlsx, and click Download.

For a month's data formatted for bookkeeping software instead: on the Documents & Data page, in the Statements tab, pick the account from the dropdown, click the vertical dots at the far right of a row, and choose QuickBooks CSV or NetSuite CSV.

flows.title: Download a monthly statement
steps: Click your org name in the top left of the dashboard and select Documents & Data, or open a specific account page and click View Statements.
Select an account from the dropdown to see all statements for the year.
Hover over or select the statement you want, then click Download; you can select more than one statement at a time.
